headline: Week 6 results
body: Ryan led the week with 132.7, beating Anthony's 101.2.
Bo took the widest win of the week over Austin, 119.1 to 57.8.
The closest game went to Dawson over Scotty, 91.3 to 81.1.
Austin finished last in scoring with 57.8.
7 superlatives went out across 6 of 10 teams.
